action_items: Minor a11y: SchoolPublicProfile.jsx line 203 <select><option> emits a hydration console error (<span> in <option>) from Radix/dev instrumentation. Cosmetic/dev-only.
critical_code_review_comments: schools_routes.decorate() still runs N+1 queries per school (offers_count, followers_count, reviews aggregate) inside list_schools and recommended_for_parent (iterates 300 docs). At scale, batch via $lookup + $group. Same concern as iteration_9.

PUT /schools/me still regenerates slug from name on every save even if name unchanged (unique_slug called unconditionally). If a school renames back-and-forth this may accumulate '-2', '-3' suffixes and break shared/bookmarked /ecoles/:slug URLs. Should short-circuit when existing.name == body.name.

recommended_for_parent trusts prefs.lat/lng from user document but never validates them; if malformed values are stored via PUT /users/me/profile they'd crash haversine_km. Consider coercing to floats and try/except.

notify() loop in create_post fans out synchronously per follower with per-user db.users.find_one — for schools with thousands of followers this will block; consider one aggregate/batch users lookup + bulk notification insert_many.

level_from_class mapping is French/Senegal-centric; class_level input is free-text — collisions possible (e.g. '1ere' matches Lycée but also 'primaire' substring 'ère' is not an issue; still, prefer exact tokens). Fine for MVP.

POST /schools/reviews `verified=true` if the reviewer has ANY conversation with the school OR any enrollment_request — a parent who merely sent a message can gain a verified badge. Consider requiring a completed enrollment or booking.
